From which countries did the United States import the most passenger cars in 2024?

SELECT c.cty_name, sum(try_cast(d.gen_val_yr AS double)) AS dollars FROM govblock_trade.census_imp_detl AS d JOIN govblock_trade.census_imports_country AS c ON c.cty_code = d.cty_code WHERE d.commodity LIKE '8703%' AND d.year = '2024' AND d.month = '12' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What was California's unemployment rate in April 2020?
SELECT year, period, value FROM govblock_labor.bls_la_data WHERE series_id = 'LASST060000000000003' AND cast(year AS varchar) = '2020' AND period = 'M04'
Which ZIP code areas stretch across the most counties?
SELECT geoid_zcta5_20, count(DISTINCT geoid_county_20) AS counties FROM govblock_census.rel2020_tab20_zcta520_county20 WHERE coalesce(geoid_zcta5_20, '') <> '' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many contributions from political committees to candidates were made in 2020?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_fec.contributions_to_candidates WHERE transaction_dt LIKE '%2020'
Which ERCOT settlement points show the highest average real-time price in the records?
Ercot Lmp By Settlement Point Cdr Lmpsrosnodenp

SELECT settlementpoint, avg(try_cast(lmp AS double)) AS dollars_per_mwh FROM govblock_solar.ercot_lmp_by_settlement_point_cdr_lmpsrosnodenp WHERE settlementpoint IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What share of active community water systems are privately owned?

SELECT round(100.0 * avg(CASE WHEN owner_type_code = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS percent FROM govblock_environment.echo_sdwa_pub_water_systems WHERE pws_activity_code = 'A' AND pws_type_code = 'CWS'
In which states are long-stay nursing home residents given antipsychotic drugs most often?

SELECT provider_state, avg(try_cast(four_quarter_average_score AS double)) AS avg_percent FROM govblock_health.cc_nh_qualitymsr_mds WHERE resident_type = 'Long Stay' AND measure_description LIKE '%antipsychotic%' AND provider_state IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many reactors reported running at full power on New Year's Day 2020?
SELECT count(*) AS reactors FROM govblock_reactors.nrc_power_status WHERE (reportdt LIKE '1/1/2020 %' OR reportdt LIKE '01/01/2020 %') AND try_cast(power AS double) = 100
Which states oversee the most active public water systems?
SELECT primacy_agency_code, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_environment.echo_sdwa_pub_water_systems WHERE pws_activity_code = 'A' AND primacy_agency_code IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many generators are planned to retire, by the operators' own reports?
SELECT count(DISTINCT plant_code || '-' || generator_id) AS generators FROM govblock_energy.eia860_generator_y_sheet_operable WHERE trim(planned_retirement_year) <> ''
Which states have the most providers enrolled in Medicare?
Medicare Fee For Service Public Provider Enrollment
SELECT state_cd, count(DISTINCT npi) AS providers FROM govblock_health.cms_medicare_fee_for_service_public_provider_enrollment GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many trademark applications claim colour as part of the mark?
SELECT count(*) AS marks FROM govblock_trademarks.tm_case_file WHERE cast(draw_color_file_in AS varchar) = '1'
Which Energy Department labs and research organisations have the most records in OSTI?

SELECT json_extract_scalar(research_orgs, '$[0]') AS organisation, count(*) AS records FROM govblock_research.osti_records WHERE json_extract_scalar(research_orgs, '$[0]') IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What share of transmission line segments run underground?
SELECT round(100.0 * avg(CASE WHEN type LIKE '%UNDERGROUND%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS percent FROM govblock_siting.hifld_electric_power_transmission_lines
Which states send in the most vehicle safety complaints?
SELECT state, count(*) AS complaints FROM govblock_vehicles.nhtsa_complaints GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What was the peak hourly load on Long Island in July 2019?
SELECT max(try_cast(integrated_load AS double)) AS highest FROM govblock_solar.nyiso_zonal_load_hourly_palintegrated WHERE name = 'LONGIL' AND time_stamp LIKE '07/%/2019%'
Where in Texas are one-bedroom fair market rents lowest?
SELECT countyname, min(try_cast(fmr1 AS double)) AS one_bedroom FROM govblock_housing.hud_fmr_fmrs_sheet_excel_data WHERE state_alpha = 'TX' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 ASC LIMIT 10
How many device reports in 2023 described a death?
SELECT count(*) AS reports FROM govblock_health.fda_device_event WHERE event_type = 'Death' AND date_received LIKE '2023%'
Which funders have the most grant awards listed?
SELECT display_name, try_cast(awards_count AS double) AS awards FROM govblock_scholarly.openalex_funders ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many PubChem bioassays were deposited by ChEMBL?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.pubchem_bioassay_aid2depositorname WHERE depositorname = 'ChEMBL'
Which counties have the most private hospital jobs?
Jobs and Wages by County and Industry

SELECT t.area_title, try_cast(q.annual_avg_emplvl AS double) AS jobs FROM govblock_labor.qcew_annual AS q JOIN govblock_labor.qcew_area_titles AS t ON t.area_fips = q.area_fips WHERE q.agglvl_code = '75' AND q.own_code = '5' AND q.industry_code = '622' AND q.year = '2023' ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
How many CPSC recalls concern children's products or toys?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_consumer.cpsc_recalls WHERE lower(title) LIKE '%child%' OR lower(title) LIKE '%toy%'
Which states' institutions have received the most NSF award money since 2020?
SELECT statename, round(sum(try_cast(awardamount AS double))) AS dollars FROM govblock_grants.nsf_awards WHERE substr(awardeffectivedate, 7, 4) >= '2020' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What is the average size of a federal sub-award?
SELECT avg(try_cast(subaward_amount AS double)) AS average FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_db_rpt_subaward_search
Which companies list the most drug products with the FDA?
SELECT labeler_name, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_health.fda_drug_ndc WHERE labeler_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many small molecules does GDB-11 enumerate?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.gdb_gdb11
Which organisations collaborate on the most clinical trials?
SELECT name, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_health.ct_sponsors WHERE role = 'collaborator' AND name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many hospitals filed Medicare cost reports for fiscal year 2024?
SELECT count(DISTINCT rpt_rec_num) AS reports FROM govblock_health.hcris_hosp10_nmrc WHERE hcris_fy = '2024'
Which Treasury securities hold the record for the highest auction rate?
SELECT concat(security_term, ' ', security_type) AS security, try_cast(high_rate_pct AS double) AS record_rate FROM govblock_treasury.record_setting_auction ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
How many different drug products have a national average acquisition cost?
SELECT count(DISTINCT ndc) AS products FROM govblock_health.medicaid_nadac
Which FCC licence files hold the most active licences?
SELECT uls_file, count(*) AS active_licences FROM govblock_consumer.fcc_uls_l_hd WHERE column05 = 'A' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How did the number of adverse drug event reports change from 2010 to 2020?
SELECT substr(receivedate, 1, 4) AS year, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_health.fda_drug_event WHERE substr(receivedate, 1, 4) IN ('2010', '2020') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
Which power plants in Pennsylvania emitted the most sulfur dioxide in 2010?
SELECT facility_name, sum(so2_mass_lbs) AS so2_lbs FROM govblock_environment.campd_emissions_hourly WHERE state = 'PA' AND year(date) = 2010 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How did the number of documents posted to Regulations.gov change from 2010 to 2024?

SELECT substr(replace(posteddate, '"', ''), 1, 4) AS year, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_regulations.regulations_gov_documents WHERE substr(replace(posteddate, '"', ''), 1, 4) IN ('2010', '2024') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
Which states had the highest average marketplace premium for a 40-year-old in 2021?

SELECT statecode, avg(try_cast(individualrate AS double)) AS avg_premium FROM govblock_health.marketplace_rate_puf WHERE businessyear = '2021' AND age = '40' AND statecode IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many awards were funded with COVID-19 relief money?
SELECT sum(try_cast(award_count AS double)) AS total FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_db_rpt_covid_faba_spending WHERE spending_level = 'subtier_agency'
Which wind farms in Iowa have the largest number of turbines?
SELECT p_name, count(*) AS turbines FROM govblock_energy.wind_uswtdb_uswtdb_v WHERE t_state = 'IA' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many voting-age citizens live in the Bronx?
SELECT try_cast(cvap_est AS double) AS citizens_18_plus FROM govblock_elections.cvap_county WHERE geoname = 'Bronx County, New York' AND lntitle = 'Total'
Which grades have the most public school students nationwide?

SELECT grade, sum(try_cast(student_count AS double)) AS students FROM govblock_education.ccd_sch_052 WHERE school_year = '2024-2025' AND total_indicator LIKE 'Category Set A%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many pension plans reported a funding deficiency on Schedule R?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_nonprofits.dol_f_sch_r WHERE try_cast(pen_funding_deficiency_amt AS double) > 0
Which states lost the most pedestrians to traffic crashes in 2022?
SELECT statename, count(*) AS pedestrians_killed FROM govblock_vehicles.fars_person WHERE per_typ = '5' AND inj_sev = '4' AND cast(death_yr AS varchar) = '2022' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Does the library hold more CRS reports or GAO reports?
SELECT source, count(*) AS reports FROM govblock_oversight.oversight_reports GROUP BY 1 LIMIT 10
In which grid areas was the most wholesale electricity delivered in 2023?

SELECT point_of_delivery_balancing_authority AS grid_area, round(sum(try_cast(standardized_quantity AS double))) AS mwh FROM govblock_energy.ferceqr_transactions WHERE year_quarter LIKE '2023%' AND product_name = 'ENERGY' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How did sulfur dioxide from U.S. power plants change from 1995 to 2023?
SELECT year(date) AS year, sum(so2_mass_lbs) AS so2_lbs FROM govblock_environment.campd_emissions_hourly WHERE year(date) IN (1995, 2023) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
At what hours of the day is New York's electricity demand highest on average?

SELECT hour_number, round(avg(try_cast(demand_mw AS double))) AS avg_mw FROM govblock_solar.eia930_region WHERE balancing_authority = 'NYIS' AND substr(data_date, 7, 4) = '2023' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many FDIC-insured banks are still active today?
SELECT count(*) AS banks FROM govblock_finance.fdic_institutions WHERE cast(active AS varchar) = '1'
In which months of 2022 did the most people die on the roads?
SELECT monthname, sum(try_cast(fatals AS integer)) AS deaths FROM govblock_vehicles.fars_accident WHERE cast(year AS varchar) = '2022' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many wind turbines reach higher than 150 meters at the blade tip?
SELECT count(*) AS turbines FROM govblock_energy.wind_uswtdb_uswtdb_v WHERE try_cast(t_ttlh AS double) > 150
Which countries publish the most patents that name chemical compounds?
SELECT country, count(*) AS patents FROM govblock_chemistry.surechembl_patents GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
